issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Pneumatic.raisePressure(int) with return type void, but the solution repository's Pneumatic interface declares raisePressure(int) returning boolean. Meanwhile the solution's implementing classes (LaunchedDropdownTower and LaunchedRollerCoaster) implement a void raisePressure(int) method. This mismatch both contradicts the UML/specification and creates an internal inconsistency in the solution that would prevent compilation.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the raisePressure method signature across all artifacts. Preferably change the Pneumatic interface in both template and solution to declare 'void raisePressure(int pressureIncrease);' to match the UML/problem statement, and ensure all implementing classes use the same void return type. Alternatively, if a boolean return is intended, update the UML/problem statement and all implementations to use boolean consistently.
